mapper.select: SELECT I.RETURNABLE FROM SF_RESOURCE_STOCK S JOIN SF_RESOURCE_ITEM I ON I.ITEM_ID = S.ITEM_ID WHERE S.STOCK_ID = #{stockId}
mapper.update: UPDATE SF_RESOURCE_STOCK SET TOTAL_QTY = TOTAL_QTY - #{quantity}, UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE STOCK_ID = #{stockId} AND TOTAL_QTY - #{quantity} >= AVAILABLE_QTY
UPDATE SF_RESOURCE_REQUEST SET ARRIVED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP, UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE REQUEST_ID = #{requestId} AND ARRIVED_AT IS NULL AND STATUS IN ('DISPATCHED', 'SETTLED', 'COMPLETED')
mapper.select: SELECT NVL(SUM(APPLIED_QTY), 0) FROM SF_RESOURCE_RETURN WHERE REQUEST_ID = #{requestId} AND STATUS = 'PENDING'
mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_SF_RESOURCE_RETURN.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO SF_RESOURCE_RETURN (RETURN_ID, REQUEST_ID, APPLIED_QTY, STATUS, APPLY_MEMO, APPLICANT_ID) VALUES (#{returnId}, #{requestId}, #{appliedQty}, 'PENDING', #{applyMemo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{applicantId})
mapper.sql: RT.RETURN_ID, RT.REQUEST_ID, RT.APPLIED_QTY, RT.STATUS, RT.APPLY_MEMO, RT.APPLICANT_ID, AM.NAME AS APPLICANT_NAME, RT.APPLIED_AT, RT.PROCESSED_BY, PM.NAME AS PROCESSED_BY_NAME, RT.PROCESSED_AT, RT.REJECT_REASON, R.INCIDENT_ID, INC.TITLE AS INCIDENT_TITLE, I.NAME AS ITEM_NAME, I.UNIT, D.NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, R.QUANTITY AS REQUEST_QUANTITY, R.STATUS AS REQUEST_STATUS, R.RETURNED_QTY, R.LOST_QTY

FROM SF_RESOURCE_RETURN RT JOIN SF_RESOURCE_REQUEST R ON R.REQUEST_ID = RT.REQUEST_ID JOIN SF_INCIDENT INC ON INC.INCIDENT_ID = R.INCIDENT_ID JOIN SF_RESOURCE_STOCK S ON S.STOCK_ID = R.STOCK_ID JOIN SF_DEPARTMENT D ON D.DEPARTMENT_ID = S.DEPARTMENT_ID JOIN SF_RESOURCE_ITEM I ON I.ITEM_ID = S.ITEM_ID JOIN SF_MEMBER AM ON AM.MEMBER_ID = RT.APPLICANT_ID LEFT JOIN SF_MEMBER PM ON PM.MEMBER_ID = RT.PROCESSED_BY
mapper.update: UPDATE SF_RESOURCE_REQUEST SET RETURNED_QTY = RETURNED_QTY + #{quantity}, STATUS = CASE WHEN RETURNED_QTY + LOST_QTY + #{quantity} = QUANTITY THEN 'SETTLED' ELSE 'DISPATCHED' END, UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE REQUEST_ID = #{requestId} AND STATUS = 'DISPATCHED' AND RETURNED_QTY + LOST_QTY + #{quantity} <= QUANTITY

UPDATE SF_RESOURCE_REQUEST SET LOST_QTY = LOST_QTY + #{lostQty}, STATUS = CASE WHEN RETURNED_QTY + LOST_QTY + #{lostQty} = QUANTITY THEN 'SETTLED' ELSE 'DISPATCHED' END, UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE REQUEST_ID = #{requestId} AND STATUS = 'DISPATCHED' AND RETURNED_QTY + LOST_QTY = #{expectedProcessedQty} AND RETURNED_QTY + LOST_QTY + #{lostQty} <= QUANTITY
